verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json covering its public REST API (36 paths). Its rendered API reference is generated directly from that spec via Redoc. The probe's 404s were on different hightouch.com paths, so they do not contradict the published spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of downloading the spec, and evidence that the spec also covers the Events HTTP Tracking API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
